text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, touring southern Biskra and el Oued provinces, urged local authorities to make most of the country's resources to spur communities' development.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf pledges in United Nations Assembly policies to forge a just world.
- State-owned oil and gas firm Sonatrach's chairman Nazim Zouioueche forecast Algeria's oil output to reach one million barrels per day by the year 2,000.
- Car bomb kills 18 people and wounds more than 70 on Friday in Boufarik, south of Algiers.
